fields.description: The role this person holds in the mission: County Commissioner, Branch Coordinator, Ward Administrator. Recorded as free text rather than a Link, because a stakeholder is usually somebody outside the society whom no register here holds. Never read by code.
fields.label: Designation

fields.description: Who they are. Optional, because a terms of reference is often written naming the office rather than the person holding it, and an office outlasts its holder.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: How to reach them during the mission. Printed on the terms of reference so a deployed volunteer has it on the paper they carry.
fields.label: Phone Number

fields.description: Optional. Printed alongside the phone number where a society works with a stakeholder by email.
fields.label: Email
